discovery_notes: Follow-up 6 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456, 489, 513, 534); reuses their keys. 29 standard searches, snippets only; most HKDL values from search-engine summaries of HKMSG bulletins. New: SHDR monthly series Storytellers Statue (2nd, 2019-04-26), Steamboat Willie Fountain, Mickey Avenue; HKDL Graduation 2019 set (2 pins, unnamed); Jan-Mar pre-sale Bambi LE100; Penguin Waiters, Miss Piggy, Dumbo on-key LE400; PIN-GO Pooh/Tigger/Piglet (quoted captions) + Eeyore/Roo; Toy Story flower-egg LE600 Jessie/Woody/Bo Peep/Buzz (held); 14th-anniv Magic Access LE500. Partial release evidence: 14th Mickey, CNY Donald&Goofy and Cookie&friends captions. Conflicts: Genie/Bo Peep key LE400 vs 300, Rex egg LE600 vs 500. Carousell not used.
